item.title: By: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.dc:creator: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.description:
Russel. Thanks for your suggestion. I actually already have access to a subversion server hosted at a remote location. The only thing is, that I often run into “enterprisey” rules about not putting business sensitive data on a foreign server outside corporate firewalls.

Maybe it’s just the clients that I work with…

item.title: By: Russell Quinn
item.dc:creator: Russell Quinn
item.description: I’d suggest setting up some hosting somewhere and having your repository in a remote location (you can do this over the discussed http protocol), then you don’t have to worry about a volatile repository on your local machine (laptop?) or merging into the main one later.
